recommendations.A_math500_worth_running: yes — real problem text + gold, 500/500 scorer coverage, natural 3-node DAG; BUT the concurrent six-arm run (200 tasks, numeric-only universe, weaker normalizer) already occupies the domain and the GPU; decide first whether it stands
recommendations.B_mbpp_over_humaneval: yes — MBPP embeds 3 real unit tests per task (deterministic deployable signal); HumanEval lacks canonical tests in the release and would need an external dataset fetch
recommendations.C_recommended_freeze_size: 100 fresh tasks per domain (sha256('xdomain:'+index) ascending, excluding frozen-200 for math, excluding dedup-second-indices and helper-dependent tasks for mbpp); final count pending user decision on the concurrent math run

D_expected_model_calls.math_six_arms_shared_cache: ~900-1,100 calls per 100-task domain (3 nodes x 3 models x 100 + bounded dynamic repair)
D_expected_model_calls.code_six_arms_shared_cache: ~700-1,000 calls per 100-task domain (plan/implement x 3 models x 100 + bounded repair loop)
D_expected_model_calls.note: six arms share node-level call cache exactly like the finance multidag panels; the concurrent math run is already consuming its own share

E_which_arms_have_meaning.Type_Router: yes (node-type prior, mirrors the finance result)
E_which_arms_have_meaning.Dynamic_DAG: yes, strongest on code (test-failure repair loop is a deployable, deterministic trigger); on math the trigger is consistency/format only, so dynamic value is expected smaller
E_which_arms_have_meaning.Oracle: yes (finite candidate ceiling within the executed node-model matrix)
E_which_arms_have_meaning.honest_caveat: six arms are all interpretable, but the math domain's deployable signal is weaker than code's; if the paper wants a decisive 'selective dynamic' replication, MBPP is the stronger witness

recommendations.verdict_summary: Math500: runnable, scorer fully ready (supersedes the release scorer); currently occupied by a concurrent 200-task six-arm run whose numeric-only filter is unjustified given our 500/500 scorer — user decision gate required. MBPP: runnable and preferred over HumanEval, strongest deployable failure signals, no reference-solution leak possible. Recommended final configuration: Math500 (pending concurrent-run decision) + MBPP 100 fresh tasks each; nothing is frozen in this audit.
